minutes.headline: Conservation Commission approved a bird-habitat forest plan and an updated Lake Shirley order, over objections from the lake manager.
minutes.summary: The commission approved the Forest Stewardship bird-habitat plan for the Hollows Grove conservation area and issued a negative determination for a generator at Sunset Lane. It worked through a restoration plan for violations at a riverfront development, and debated an updated Lake Shirley order of conditions, with the lake manager's representative disputing the commission's right to amend. Other items were enforcement updates, a new homeowner notification policy and approval of minutes.

what_happened.line: The commission approved the Forest Stewardship bird-habitat plan for the Hollows Grove Conservation Area.
It approved an updated order of conditions for Lake Shirley after a dispute over whether the commission may amend the order and its extension.
It issued a negative determination for the generator and trench at 30 and 50 Sunset Lane.
On the riverfront restoration plan it set boulder, tree and June 15 completion conditions, with no final resolution on the 131 and 133 Shirley Road matter.
The 179 Island Road hearing was continued to May 1, and 63 Prospect Street enforcement continues pending an owner plan.

why_it_matters: The Lake Shirley order sets the conditions that govern work around the lake, and the dispute over amending it bears on how far the commission's conditions can reach.
The restoration conditions and enforcement actions show what the commission can require of waterfront owners who disturb protected buffer areas, including planting and the cost of it.
watch_next: May 1 meeting: 179 Island Road hearing resumes, and the 63 Prospect Street owner's plan is due before it.
July 18: planned hearing on the notice of intent for 131/133.
